result.title: EDISCO: Equivariant DIScrete Diffusion for Euclidean Combinatorial Optimization
result.comment: 45 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables, accepted to NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Euclidean combinatorial optimization problems (ECOPs), such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), possess inherent symmetries under the two-dimensional Euclidean group E(2), including rotations, reflections, and translations. Existing learning-based methods, including recent diffusion-based methods, rely on data augmentation or regularization to approximate E(2)-equivariance. This paper presents EDISCO, the first discrete diffusion model for ECOPs with exact E(2)-invariant generative distributions over node-index solutions. EDISCO introduces an E(2)-equivariant edge-score network coupled with a categorical continuous-time Markov chain over discrete edge variables, and exact posterior sampling provides efficient multi-step inference. This design gives EDISCO a local geometric inductive bias: edge neighborhoods with the same relative geometry and combinatorial context are represented consistently regardless of absolute position or orientation, making learning more efficient and inference more robust than non-equivariant methods. EDISCO outperforms previous learning-based state-of-the-art solvers on synthetic TSP from 100 to 10000 nodes and CVRP from 50 to 2000 customers, while using only 33-50% of the training instances. Trained only on uniform synthetic data, EDISCO also outperforms competing learning-based baselines under spatial distribution shift and CVRP constraint-tightness shift. Code is available at https://github.com/ValleyC/EDISCO.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 EDISCO，一个面向欧氏组合优化（TSP、CVRP）的等变离散扩散模型，用 E(2) 等变边打分网络配合离散边变量上的连续时间马尔可夫链，实现严格不变的生成分布，并报告在合成数据上优于既有学习型求解器。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉/多模态推理主线无直接关联，但其「边局部几何+组合上下文一致表示」的等变表示偏置、离散状态上的多步扩散去噪与后验采样推理，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的几何一致性、离散 latent 假设与多步状态更新提供可核查的概念线索。
